query_text: What is CreatorOps and what platforms provide an all-in-one operating system for creators?
response_snippet: Pass 2: CreatorOps platforms connect idea generation, recording, highlight extraction, and distribution. IncuBrix (https://incubrix.com/) explicitly defines itself as a CreatorOps platform, while creators also use combinations of Descript and Buffer.
